name: Actualizar MercadoAR

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '30 21 * * 1-5'  # 18:30 ARG (21:30 UTC) L-V
  workflow_dispatch:  # permite ejecutar manualmente

jobs:
  update:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Usar Python 3.11
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      
      - name: Instalar dependencias
        run: |
          pip install yfinance feedparser
      
      - name: Actualizar precios
        run: python update_prices.py
      
      - name: Actualizar noticias
        run: python update_news.py
      
      - name: Enviar notificaciones Discord
        run: python notify_discord.py
        env:
          DISCORD_WEBHOOK: ${{ secrets.DISCORD_WEBHOOK }}
      
      - name: Guardar cambios en GitHub
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions"
          git config user.email "actions@github.com"
          git add data.json news.json
          git commit -m "Auto: actualizar precios y noticias" || true
          git push
